intake.title: Start with the restaurant's public website or Instagram
intake.body: Archer reads accessible brand signals, labels observations and inferences, and turns an approved event brief into three downloadable images.
intake.uploadHint: Website, product page, or Instagram profile, post, or Reel
intake.transferNote: Public assets only. Archer never bypasses private profiles, login walls, CAPTCHA, or unavailable media.

workflow.heading: Send real footage. Get the promo out before the event.
workflow.body: A three-step concierge workflow built around your team's calendar, brand rules, and approval chain.

steps.title: Send
steps.description: Share the real phone footage your venue team already captured.
details: Actual dishes, rooms, crowds, and events
One folder per venue or event

steps.title: Brand
steps.description: Archer cleans, edits, captions, and resizes without replacing what was filmed.

steps.title: Approve
steps.description: One named approver reviews a single link while Archer owns the clock.

delivery.heading: Four platform-native cuts. One deadline.
delivery.body: Each delivery is framed vertically, checked against the venue brand, and tied to the same event deadline.

guarantee.label: Deadline ownership
guarantee.heading: The clip is only useful before the event.
guarantee.body: Before editing starts, we agree the event deadline, named approver, delivery window, and revision window.

showcase.heading: This is the style.
showcase.body: AI-generated previews illustrating Archer's visual direction, not footage from an actual client or venue.
showcase.notice: These are illustrative style previews, not real pilot deliveries. Approved client work will replace them here once available.

features.heading: Capacity for every venue without replacing your editor.
features.body: Archer extends the production team around repeatable, deadline-sensitive promo work.

items.title: Brand consistency
items.body: Keep every venue's colors, type, end cards, captions, and tone in a reusable kit.

items.title: Approval turnaround
items.body: Route one consolidated review to one named approver instead of chasing a group chat.

items.title: Deadline ownership
items.body: Plan backward from doors open, with delivery and revision windows agreed before editing.

items.title: Platform resizing
items.body: Deliver deliberate 9:16 versions for Reels, TikTok, Shorts, and Snapchat.

items.title: Real footage only
items.body: Clean, edit, caption, and brand the footage you shot. Never synthesize the venue or event.

items.title: Editor capacity expansion
items.body: Absorb repeatable promo volume so your editor can protect higher-value creative work.

tracker.heading: Every venue, event, approval, and deadline in one view.
tracker.body: An operational tracker keeps the weekly production queue visible without pretending to be a live client dashboard.
tracker.sampleDisclaimer: Example workflow · not live client data

benefits.label: One weekly queue
benefits.body: See what arrived, what is moving, and what needs a decision.

benefits.label: One accountable approver
benefits.body: Make ownership visible before a deadline becomes a fire drill.

benefits.label: One delivery clock
benefits.body: Tie every platform cut to the event, not an open-ended content calendar.

meetArcher.heading: Meet Archer.
meetArcher.body: Archer takes repeatable event-promo editing off your team's critical path. Your editor keeps creative ownership. Archer adds the capacity, brand discipline, and deadline follow-through.

fit.heading: Who this is not for.
fit.body: Archer is designed for a specific operational problem, so the boundaries are as important as the promise.

items.label: Not for
items.title: Synthetic venue content
items.body: Archer does not invent dishes, rooms, crowds, performers, or events that were not captured.

items.label: Probably not for
items.title: Occasional single-location posting
items.body: A one-off post can use the editing demo, but it does not need the deadline-driven concierge service.

items.label: Built for
items.title: Multi-venue hospitality teams
items.body: Agencies and groups already collecting real footage across restaurants, bars, lounges, and nightlife venues.

pilot.heading: Prove the deadline workflow on real events.
pilot.body: Choose the venues and event calendar, name one approver, and agree delivery and revision windows before the first footage arrives.
pilot.secondaryPrompt: I want the one-post editing demo. I will share one of my existing Instagram posts for platform-native repurposing.
pilot.demoNote: The one-post demo shows editing capability. It is not the deadline-driven, multi-venue product experience.

steps.title: Name one approver
steps.body: Keep feedback consolidated and ownership clear.

steps.title: Agree the clock

footer.tagline: Real hospitality footage, branded and delivered before the event deadline.

costCopy.breakdown: How the all-in AI cost is built
costCopy.budgetOnly: This is your total budget. Switch to Cost breakdown to itemize it; no split has been assumed.
costCopy.benefitNotice: Modeled benefits, not charges. Crossed-out amounts are spending you expect to avoid, not discounts on the AI bill.
costCopy.allocation: Returned hours are capacity, not automatic savings. Only the portions you assign to actual spending reductions or additional contribution receive a monetary value.

copy.workloadIntro: Model recurring campaign packages for hospitality venues and restaurant groups. Archer prepares the work; a human still approves it before publication.
copy.costIntro: AI, media, tools, platform and infrastructure costs are delivery assumptions, separate from Archer's customer price.
copy.valueIntro: Returned editor hours are capacity. Assign them to one validated value basis: internal contribution or actual avoided spending.
copy.reviewNote: Existing-team review uses returned capacity. Additional paid review is included in operating cost, not deducted again from team capacity.
copy.budgetNote: The budget must include models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review. Do not include unchanged payroll as new spending.
copy.itemizedNote: Token usage is calculated from volume × tokens per output. Extra media, tools and infrastructure stay at zero unless they apply. Additional paid review is calculated from review hours and its rate.
copy.customerBenefit: Modeled production savings before Archer price
copy.annualNote: The same monthly assumptions, without growth or compounding. Hiring savings last only for the entered period.
copy.methodBody: Operating burden removed (negative productivity) returns capacity. Higher-value work (potential positive productivity) creates economic value only if that capacity is used. Hours alone are not cash savings. Token cost uses a modeled input/output mix, not a provider quote.
copy.formulaLabel: Customer ROI = (modeled production savings − Archer customer price) ÷ Archer customer price. Use one value basis and validate it with a paid pilot.
copy.allocationNote: Each hour can be allocated once. Unallocated hours remain capacity, with no monetary value.
copy.overlapLabel: These benefits are distinct; I have excluded costs and losses already counted elsewhere.
copy.overlapNote: Error and risk estimates exclude labor savings and the same incident must not appear in both categories. Contribution excludes AI costs, which are deducted separately.
copy.hiringLabel: This hire was genuinely planned and the allocated capacity can cover the work.
copy.reviewedLabel: I have reviewed my outcomes; unselected outcomes have no financial value in this estimate.
copy.throughputResult: Additional work supported by capacity and demand
copy.assumptionsIncomplete: Complete the selected assumptions to calculate financial value.
copy.allocationError: Allocated hours exceed the net capacity available. Reduce the allocations.
copy.reviewError: Review takes more time than the work reduced. No positive capacity is available at these assumptions.
copy.cashError: Avoided spending cannot exceed current spending or have positive value with no hours allocated.
copy.hiringError: Allocated capacity must cover the planned hire hours. Confirm the planned hire and its duration.
copy.riskError: The after probability cannot exceed the before probability for a loss-reduction estimate.
copy.overlapError: Confirm the benefits do not overlap before including them in the financial result.
copy.boundsError: Use values within the displayed limits.
copy.noCurrencyChange: Language changes formatting, not your currency or assumptions.
copy.paybackOutsideTerm: Not recovered within the modeled term

tokens_per_output.label: Tokens per campaign package

budget.label: Estimated monthly operating budget
budget.help: Include token usage, models/media, tools, infrastructure, Gabriel fees and additional paid review.

model_cost.label: Models and media generation
model_cost.help: Image and video generation for this package, counted separately from the token envelope.

tools_cost.label: Tools and integrations
tools_cost.help: Browser sessions, connectors and other metered services. Enter zero if none.

infrastructure_cost.label: Infrastructure
infrastructure_cost.help: Incremental hosting, storage and compute for this workload. Enter zero if none.

platform_cost.label: Other delivery and support cost

personal_value_per_hour.label: Optional value you assign to an hour
personal_value_per_hour.help: An optional personal comparison only. This is not salary, wages or guaranteed cash savings.

review_rate.label: Additional paid review per hour
review_rate.help: Actual extra reviewer spending, not the salary of an unchanged employee.

cash_hours.label: Hours that remove paid work
cash_hours.help: Allocate only work whose overtime, contractor or processing spend will actually stop.

cash_baseline.label: Current monthly spending on that work
cash_baseline.help: The cash budget from which the reduction will come.

cash_avoided.label: Overflow invoice you would stop
cash_avoided.help: One production invoice that actually stops. Count it once.

higher_value_hours.label: Hours kept for creative direction
higher_value_hours.help: Editor time redirected from repetitive variants.

contribution_rate.label: In-house editor capacity / hr
contribution_rate.help: Incremental value of an editor hour on direction, not a freelance rate copied as salary saved.

throughput_hours.label: Hours used for additional volume
throughput_hours.help: This allocation cannot also be used for advisory work or spending reductions.

extra_minutes.label: Team minutes per additional unit
extra_minutes.help: The remaining human effort, including review, needed to deliver one more unit.

demand.label: Additional units with expected demand
demand.help: Capacity alone is not demand. Enter the extra monthly work you expect to take on.

unit_margin.label: Contribution per additional unit
unit_margin.help: Incremental revenue less delivery costs; AI operating costs are deducted separately.

hiring_hours.label: Hours covering the planned hire
hiring_hours.help: Allocate capacity to specific planned work, not a generic full-time-equivalent estimate.

planned_hours.label: Monthly hours the planned hire would cover
planned_hours.help: The allocated capacity must cover this entire workload.

hire_cost.label: Monthly hire cost actually deferred
hire_cost.help: Use the cost of a genuinely planned hire, not the salary of someone already employed.

hire_months.label: Months that hire is deferred
hire_months.help: One to twelve months; the annual estimate stops counting savings after this period.

incidents.label: Expected avoided errors per month
incidents.help: Use your baseline and expected reduction. Exclude incidents also counted as risk reduction.

incident_cost.label: Incremental cost per error
incident_cost.help: Exclude labor, refunds or other losses already included elsewhere.

probability_before.label: Monthly loss probability before
probability_before.help: Your estimate, not a guaranteed risk assessment.

probability_after.label: Monthly loss probability after
probability_after.help: Use the same event and monthly time horizon as the baseline.

loss.label: Loss exposure for that event
loss.help: Exclude error incidents and spending already counted. This is uncertain expected value, not cash saved.

days_before.label: Cycle time before, in days
days_before.help: Elapsed time from start to completion, separate from hands-on effort.

days_after.label: Cycle time after, in days
days_after.help: Shown as an operational change only, without an assumed monetary value.

opportunity: Creative direction and less paid production overflow

outcomes.label: Keep editors on creative direction
outcomes.help: Use returned hours on direction and approval, not on repetitive variants.

outcomes.label: Stop one overflow production invoice
outcomes.help: Count a contractor invoice that actually stops. Do not also count those hours as salary saved.

copy.heading: Pricing & ROI
copy.intro: Choose a plan. See your forecast.
copy.equivalents: Billed monthly. Day and week figures are averages, not daily or weekly charges or guaranteed returns.
copy.timeNote: Forecast time value is returned capacity, not cash received or a payroll reduction. Net minutes include checking and approval.
copy.estimateNote: Planning estimates are separate from measured ROI. Only accepted outcomes and comparable recorded costs support measured returns.
copy.limitNote: For more usage or separately quoted work, contact us. This estimate covers the included plan only.
copy.timeFormula: Forecast time value = included work × fixed net minutes returned ÷ 60 × reference hourly value.
copy.profitFormula: Contribution profit = eligible recommendation sessions × conversion uplift ÷ 100 × profit per additional order.
copy.proceedsFormula: Incremental proceeds = lots or pickups × (net proceeds afterward − net proceeds beforehand).
copy.roiFormula: Net = benefit − app subscription cost. ROI = net ÷ app subscription cost × 100. Free plans have no ROI percentage.

profiles.label: Social

inputs.label: Social packs per month
inputs.help: Forecast assumes the included monthly allowance is used. Higher draft tiers increase capacity and price together.

inputs.label: Minutes saved
inputs.help: Fixed forecast after preparation, checking, approval and rework; not a measured saving.

inputs.label: Hourly value
inputs.help: Fixed reference valuation of returned capacity; not cash received or a salary reduction.

offer.allowance: 8 social packs with bounded media usage
offer.extras: Premium media, additional generation and full cinematic production are separately quoted.

assumptions: Forecast revision 2026-10-13. Full included usage, available work and a linear 1×/2×/3× capacity scenario; no extra demand is guaranteed.

Authored task budget: 120 manual minutes versus 96 assisted human minutes per work unit, including checking, approval and rework. The 24 net minutes (20%) is a scenario, not observed persona performance.

The 20% time-reduction scenario is informed by research on AI-assisted knowledge tasks. Its results do not establish savings for this persona or for every task: https://aiinstitute.hbs.edu/navigating-the-jagged-technological-frontier/

Returned business capacity is valued at €34.90/hour, the EU whole-economy hourly labour-cost reference for 2025. It is not a profession-specific rate or a payroll saving: https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/en/web/products-eurostat-news/w/ddn-20260331-2

All figures are forecasts. Setup effort, learning time and any additional services are excluded; actual net returns can be lower or negative. No sale, placement, funding, learning result or social outcome is monetized.

Free access renews monthly with the displayed basic allowance. Premium media, integrations and extra usage are excluded. Paid tiers have a seven-day trial; trial usage is capped at one basic free allowance, not an extra full monthly allowance. Prices shown are recurring prices after the trial. These are authored offer proposals; the calculator does not provision entitlements or change billing.
Basic free work covers 25% of the full work unit; its time-value forecast is reduced by the same fraction.
